title: Elf o Karu Monotachi: Hanafuda-hen
native_title: エルフを狩るモノたち ～花札編～
overview:
Elf o Karu Monotachi: Hanafuda-hen is an adult hanafuda card game based on the anime Those Who Hunt Elves. Three people stranded in a fantasy world can only get home by gathering the fragments of a return spell that has been printed onto elves, so they must win at cards to undress the elves and recover the pieces.

In story mode you take on a series of opponents stage by stage, including Celcia Marieclaire.

- Three hanafuda games: Koi-Koi, Hana-Awase and Oicho-Kabu
- Hand names are shown when you are one card away from completing them
- Progress is saved at each stage, so a loss can be retried from there
